text:
Thanks for asking, and I'm sorry for the worry. If the courier can't find your parcel, the investigation (up to **5 business days**) ends with it being confirmed lost, and you choose one of these:

- **A free replacement.** We send the order again at no cost.
- **A full refund.** It goes back to your original payment method. Once issued, cards take **5-10 business days** and digital wallets **3-5 business days**. If you'd rather have **Leafy store credit**, it's issued instantly and never expires.

If your replacement includes live plants, they ship **Monday to Wednesday only**. A weather hold of up to 7 days is possible if transit forecasts are very cold or hot, and we'd email you if that happened.

You don't need to do anything to get this far, other than send me your **order number** (LF- followed by six digits) so I can open the investigation today. Your **$15 store credit** for the delay is still available too.

Thanks so much for your patience. Please reach out any time!
